question: Who has been re-appointed as the chairperson of the ICC Men's Cricket Committee in April 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sourav Ganguly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sourav Ganguly re-appointed as Chairperson of ICC men’s cricket committee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Sourav Ganguly** re-appointed as **chairperson of ICC Men’s Cricket Committee**.

 
 
• 
 
He first took the role in **2021**.

 
 
• 
 
Ganguly was **India's captain from 2000 to 2005**.

 
 
• 
 
He **replaces Anil Kumble**, who served **three full terms** (maximum allowed).

 
 
• 
 
**VVS Laxman** has also been **retained as a panel member**.

 
 
• 
 
Ganguly and Laxman were **longtime teammates** in the Indian national team.
